:::: {.home-bio}
Welcome! I am an applied microeconomist with research interests in environmental, health and labour economics. My current research uses quasi-experimental and structural methods to study how air pollution affects mental health, both directly and through the labour market.

I am currently a PhD student in economics at the University of Manchester, under the supervision of [Dr Ron Chan](https://sites.google.com/site/ronhschan) and [Prof Ada Wossink](https://research.manchester.ac.uk/en/persons/ada-wossink/). Prior to my PhD, I completed an MPhil in economics at the University of Oxford and a BSc in economics with finance at the University of Sheffield.
